name: Comfort Fincap Limited
about: Comfort Fincap Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company offers loans against shares, securities, properties, and mutual funds, as well as provide finance to supply chain and funding to promoter. The company was formerly known as Parasnath Textiles Limited and changed its name to Comfort Fincap Limited in June 2011. Comfort Fincap Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
